module: Flowgraph node "Bullet Time" (category repeat_instant). Slows down or pauses simulation time via simTimeAuthority. Input pins: instant (bool, hidden: applies the speed immediately instead of approaching it gradually) and value (number, 0 = game pause, slider 0 to 1). Runs every frame while the input flow is active; when the graph stops, resets the speed to 1.
notes: If value is 0, simTimeAuthority.pause(true) is called; otherwise the speed is set and then the pause is lifted.
If value is nil, speed 1 is used (but the value == 0 test is done first).

_executionStopped.desc: Called when the graph stops: resets simTimeAuthority.set(1).

postInit.desc: Configures the value pin as a float slider from 0 to 1.

work.desc: If the flow is active: pauses if value == 0, otherwise sets the speed (setInstant if instant, otherwise set) and lifts the pause.
